statement.document_title: Why Are We Still Doing This?

from_speaker: outside of hyperscalers moving compute off of their balance sheets

our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion concerns independent AI compute providers. I read demand as annual spending on their compute services, excluding the specified hyperscaler purchases.
I use calendar 2025, the latest completed annual reporting period before the post and the year explicitly used in the next sentence.
A billion dollars is an approximate magnitude, not an exact dollar ceiling.
AI labs and NVIDIA are not automatically excluded: the stated exclusion concerns hyperscalers moving compute off their balance sheets.
The passage does not identify an accounting basis or a market-wide calculation. I therefore record the basis as unknown.
criteria.support_condition: A market-wide estimate with disclosed coverage and customer exclusions places realized 2025 spending near $1 billion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable customer-level evidence establishes spending materially above or below $1 billion after applying the stated exclusion.
